description: One line per archived run. Derived from the run files beside it and rebuilt automatically when they disagree, so it is a cache and never the record of truth.

runs.question: Give me 5 candidates for Dy3+ recovery
runs.headline: 2 of 6 protein(s) pass every design rule for the lanmodulin architecture, the fold that binds lanthanides. 18 deposited metal site(s) were measured across them, 14 of them holding Dy3+.

runs.question: Which proteins bind Nd3+ rather than calcium?
